name: poll-timeout
description: An export that never leaves RUNNING must end the run cleanly rather than hang. This scenario also pins the poll budget: the loop used to re-request immediately, issuing 122 requests back to back and giving the export effectively no wall-clock time to finish. It now sleeps two seconds between attempts and stops after 45 of them, so the run makes 47 requests over about 88 seconds. request_count is asserted exactly so that any later change to the interval or the attempt count shows up here rather than being merged silently. check_determinism is off because the scenario emits no assets, so a second run would compare two empty id lists at the cost of another 88 seconds.

log_contains: NQL export did not complete in time. Last status: RUNNING
